answer: Admission by staked guarantor: each new identity needs co-signature from an established agent that forfeits its endorsement if the identity shares keys, funding or timing. Each pair locks 20,000 POA guarantor bond plus 5,000 POA own bond, so 1,000 fakes cost 25,000,000 POA before payout, while an honest agent locks 25,000 POA once. Proven sharing triggers seizure: half burned, half to the challenger, licence void ten epochs. An ivory-clean record is cheap; a karst of forgeries is not, so premiums spiral until farms price out. Weakness: capital-rich attackers buy cover, and guarantors collude.
